'''Athleenia Dannuz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], she was part of [[Satele Shan]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] coalition along with [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces under [[Darth Marr]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Athleenia Dannuz appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. She is rare champion spawn that appears at the [[Republic Forward Camp]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
